subject: Procurement runbook + kickoff call — proposed dates & milestone matrix
messages:
From: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwoodinference.com>
To: Sam Nelson <sam.nelson@acmehealth.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwoodinference.com>, Camila Reyes <camila.reyes@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Mon, 17 May 2027 14:05:00 -0700
Subject: Procurement runbook + kickoff call — proposed dates & milestone matrix

Hi Sam — great to meet last week. Per our conversation, I want to align on a short procurement kickoff to get vendor setup, PO routing, and onboarding forms squared away so we can schedule the integration work.

Proposed objectives for the call (30–45 min):
- Confirm vendor enrollment form and required legal/finance docs
- Agree PO approval flow and expected SLA for PO issuance
- Share Redwood onboarding checklist and MAP milestones (kickoff -> PO -> test env -> production)
- Assign owners and target dates for each milestone

Available times (PT): Tue 5/18 10:00–11:00, Wed 5/19 13:00–14:00, Thu 5/20 09:00–10:00. If none work, please tell us preferred windows.

Pre-reads (attached): vendor_enrollment_form.pdf, PO-approval-flow.png, redwood-onboarding-checklist.xlsx
Link to the MAP draft: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1a2B3cRUNBOOK-acme

Would you also confirm: who at Acme signs POs, any vendor portal enrollment steps, and whether you require a W-9 or equivalent?

Thanks — Jordan
Jordan Blake
Enterprise Partnerships | Redwood Inference
jordan.blake@redwoodinference.com | +1 415-555-0192

From: Sam Nelson <sam.nelson@acmehealth.com>
To: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Maya Patel <maya.patel@vendorco.com>
Date: Tue, 18 May 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Procurement runbook + kickoff call — proposed dates & milestone matrix

Thanks Jordan — Tuesday 5/18 10:00 PT works for us. I'll join along with our procurement lead (Maya Patel from VendorCo will be on the line to confirm enrollment steps).

Quick answers in advance:
- PO signatory: Finance Director (Theresa Huang) — once vendor profile is created, POs are routed through Coupa and typically issued within 3–5 business days after approvals.
- Required docs: W-9 (US entity), vendor enrollment form (we attached a signed copy of a prior vendor profile for reference), and SOC2 attestation if available.
- Portal: we use a vendor portal (vendorco@vendorportal.acmehealth.com) for tax docs and bank onboarding.

I attached the vendor profile sample we use (see attachment: acme_vendor_profile_sample.pdf). On the call, we can walk through the portal steps and the fields that often delay enrollment.

See you Tue 10:00 PT.

—Sam
Sam Nelson
Procurement Manager | Acme Health
sam.nelson@acmehealth.com | +1 617-555-0228

From: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwoodinference.com>
To: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwoodinference.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>, Camila Reyes <camila.reyes@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Tue, 18 May 2027 11:30:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Procurement runbook + kickoff call — proposed dates & milestone matrix

Perfect — I'll host the call and bring the draft MAP and success criteria. Quick internal notes / owners before the call:
- Jordan: lead the call with Acme and drive PO timeline ask (owner: jordan_blake)
- Marissa: own vendor setup once profile is live (owner: marissa_cole)
- Camila: own final SOW and DocuSign flow (owner: camila_reyes)
- Karthik: track compliance evidence and security questionnaire handoff (owner: karthik_iyer)

Success criteria for the MAP we should aim to lock on the call:
1) Vendor profile created in Acme portal within 3 business days post-call
2) PO issued (committed amount) within 10 business days post-call
3) Test environment available and credentials shared within 5 business days of PO
4) SOW signed or DocuSigned via Camila within 7 business days of PO

I'll prepare a 10-min slide with the milestone matrix and owners. Please pull any open redlines on the SOW and upload to the Drive before the call.

Karthik
Karthik Iyer
Head of Procurement Ops | Redwood Inference
karthik.iyer@redwoodinference.com

From: Camila Reyes <camila.reyes@redwoodinference.com>

Date: Thu, 19 May 2027 10:22:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Procurement runbook + kickoff call — proposed dates & milestone matrix

Thanks for confirming, Sam. Quick checklist from my side before Tuesday:
- Jordan: please confirm the exact legal entity name and remit address we should put on the vendor profile (I have "Redwood Inference, Inc.").
- Marissa: I'll need the final SOW draft and key pricing line items uploaded to the Drive by EOD Mon 5/17 so I can prepare the DocuSign envelope.
- Karthik: please attach the SOC2 summary or pointer to our portal so Acme can review during the call.

I also uploaded a clean SOW template to the MAP folder: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1a2B3cRUNBOOK-acme (file: redwood-sow-draft.docx).

If no objections, I'll circulate the calendar invite for Tue 5/18 10:00 PT and include the meeting agenda and MAP slide.

Thanks — Camila
Camila Reyes
Commercial Operations | Redwood Inference
camila.reyes@redwoodinference.com | +1 650-555-0114
